message.content: MeanReversionEUR posted a loss of 11.2% in H1 2024, with a Sharpe of -0.74 and Sortino of -0.98 indicating poor risk-adjusted returns across all 89 trades. The 23.4% maximum drawdown is alarming and suggests the strategy struggles in trending markets. With a win rate of only 41% and a worst trade of -4.6%, the edge appears insufficient to overcome transaction costs. The most actionable improvement would be adding a trend filter to suppress entries when the broader market is in a sustained directional move.
